turns.content: I'm planning a hiking trip to Yosemite next month. Can you help me organize what I'd need?

Yosemite is wonderful in spring. You'll want layered clothing, sturdy boots, a rain shell, water filtration, a topographic map, and a permit if you're doing any of the wilderness routes. The Half Dome cable permits are lottery-only so apply early.
Great. I want to attempt Half Dome. What's the lottery deadline?
The Half Dome preseason lottery runs through March 31 each year, with results posted in mid-April. Daily lotteries are also available 48 hours in advance for any unfilled permits.
What about training? I'm reasonably fit but haven't done serious elevation.

Half Dome is 14-16 miles round trip with ~4800 ft of elevation gain. Train with stairmaster sessions or hike local hills with a 20-pound pack. Build up over 6-8 weeks; do at least one 12-mile hike before the trip.
Got it. Can you remind me of the gear list one more time, condensed?
Layered clothing, sturdy boots, rain shell, water filter, map, permit, headlamp, first aid, sunscreen, gloves for the cables, and at least 3 liters of water for the day.
Last question — best time of day to start the hike?
Start at the trailhead before 5 AM. Expect 10-12 hours total. Cables typically come down by mid-October so plan accordingly if your trip extends past that.
